Hero_Desc_Joanne:
A priestess who awakened with omnipotent power upon receiving a revelation of Yggdrasil in a dream.
However, after being miserably abandoned by Yggdrasil, she received warm forgiveness from the Master.
Now, she is the most faithful follower of the Master, more than anyone else.
Album_Joanne1: The self-proclaimed "True Master," awakened by the Revelation of the Yggdrasil. After many experiences, she now acknowledges me, but back when we were enemies, she was terrifying.
Album_Joanne2: Joanne no longer holds faith in Yggdrasil. She believes that it abandoned her and that believing in me is enough. Deep down, she seems to carry a strong sense of betrayal.
Album_Joanne3: Though she can no longer perform miracles as freely as before, Joanne still seems to retain similar abilities. She can make bread appear out of nowhere or turn plain water into grape juice. Erpin even visits her sometimes when she runs out of money.
Album_Joanne4: She and Ner often clash in heated debates. Ner firmly insists that Yggdrasil never gave Joanne a true revelation, and Joanne watches Ner warily, warning that she's being deceived. She keeps telling Ner to wake up and see the truth.
Album_Joanne5: Joanne realized that a true priestess is one who doesn't fall asleep while praying. Because of this, she sometimes follows me around, mumbling prayers. It's a bit overwhelming.
Album_Joanne6: She may have a different object of faith, but... in reality, it's just like having an extra Ner. Whether it's Joanne or Ner, they both constantly follow me around, urging me to do something great. Maybe they realize this too since sometimes they look at each other like they're seeing a mirror image and get startled.
Album_Joanne7: Joanne believes that one day, I will reveal the true nature of Yggdrasil and lead Elias into enlightenment. Can I really fulfill her faith? The thought makes my head spin a little.
LoveHero_Joanne: I shall serve by your side with all my heart, Master.
Food_ChefNote_Joanne_Hate1: When Joanne asked if I liked it, I said I didn't really care for it because it was too sweet. Then she said that means she wouldn't like it either. It would have been nice if she had at least tried it before making a judgment...
Food_ChefNote_Joanne_Hate2: Joanne believes in the theory that food that tastes bitter is good for the body, while delicious food is bad. Therefore, she considers this her number one food to avoid in order to maintain a healthy Order life.
Food_ChefNote_Joanne_Like1: Joanne has loved this rich and sweet drink since before her slumber. Now that so much has changed, she's glad that the flavor of the mixed grain powder remains the same.
Food_ChefNote_Joanne_Like10: She offered a reverent prayer, saying its radiant glow and fragrance resembled the Master's grace. Then a gust scattered the powder and set off a chorus of sneezes.
Food_ChefNote_Joanne_Like2: Joanne said she liked how the distinct mint flavor made her mouth feel refreshed the more she ate. When I reminded her that she still needed to brush her teeth, she immediately started brushing.
Food_ChefNote_Joanne_Like3: Joanne seemed unfamiliar with it since she had never seen it. But after taking a bite at my suggestion, she finished the whole bowl, saying it made her body warm and satisfied. I felt quite proud.
Food_ChefNote_Joanne_Like4: Joanne was shocked by the appearance, but soon made her mind up to try it. After taking a bite earnestly, her eyes widened in surprise at the rich chocolate flavor.
Food_ChefNote_Joanne_Like5: Since Joanne said she was tired from an all-night prayer, I made a tea with this. Every time she spoke, she kept slurping, as if her mouth was watering.
Food_ChefNote_Joanne_Like6: Joanne kept fiddling with it, saying it was cute and resembled a round pebble. When I suggested we make it together sometime, she clasped her hands together in gratitude, saying it would be an honor.
Food_ChefNote_Joanne_Like7: Saying she couldn't leave any behind, Joanne put the whole thing in her mouth at once. Well, I don't think that was the real reason... It seems like she just wanted to eat a lot of chocolate...
Food_ChefNote_Joanne_Like8: She kept asking if she had to make yum yum sounds while eating, and eventually, the powder got stuck in her throat, leading to a coughing fit. As I tried to pat her back, she ran away, apologizing several times.
Food_ChefNote_Joanne_Like9: After tasting the seven flavors representing the characteristics of each race, Joanne said she would unite all the races of Elias like this candy and make them all serve me.

LoveLetter_Joanne:
Greetings, Master.

I write because there is something I wish to tell you. Thank you for overlooking my sinful actions at the beginning, for believing in me to the end, and for watching over me. The weight of that grace leaves this Joanne at a loss for how to repay it.

Master, someday the time will come when you must save Elias, just as you saved me. It will be a difficult path. I, Joanne, will always remain quietly at your side and lend you my strength.

Forever.
LoveCall_Joanne:
Greetings, Master. Please forgive this sudden call.
Ah, you ask why I contacted you.
In truth... I wished to seek your counsel.

Until now, I believed I had devoted all my strength to serving you...
But while you busied yourself spreading your grace throughout the world,
I could not stop wondering whether I had truly supported you steadfastly, and whether my efforts had been enough.
If they were not, please rebuke me even now.
Tell me that I fell short, that I failed to help you...
What? That is... not true? Thank you, Master.

...Master? Might I visit you now?
I am ashamed to say this, but I wish to calm this joy that still stirs within me... by remaining at your side.
